mappings.key_fact: Order promised in 2 days, delivered on day 6; warehouse dispatch delayed at WH-07
Enterprise customer (Meridian Retail Group) paused orders and moved volume to competitor after three of last five deliveries missed SLA in June; competitor launched 2-day express program on July 1
Enterprise customer (Kalinga Mart) cited June delivery misses on 4 POs and is evaluating competitor's express program; renewal at risk

WH-07 main conveyor failed June 25; running at ~60% throughput with 3-week spare part ETA and 14-picker staffing shortfall; ops lead explicitly stated expect SLA breaches on North-West lanes until resolved
Previous similar incident (2025-11 East region): sorter capacity constraint caused SLA to breach to 15%; temporary 3PL overflow capacity recovered SLA in 12 days

Proven mitigation: temporary 3PL overflow capacity re-routing 30% of volume recovered SLA from 15% breach rate to baseline in 12 days; playbook recommends pre-approval when hub exceeds 12% breach rate

new_hypothesis.label: WH-07 conveyor failure on June 25 reduced North-West sortation capacity to 60%, causing fulfillment SLA breaches that cascaded through July as the spare part remained on 3-week backorder; lack of temporary 3PL overflow capacity mitigation allowed the breach rate to persist rather than recover within 12 days as precedent demonstrates
